rule_or_requirement: A learned pixel-only speed adviser must preserve valid completion and shorten finished lap time against its exact pixel control.
observable_information: Frozen student and control on untouched held-out 5208–5211: matched finish, lap, progress, collision, invalid action, intervention and latency evidence.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Run the unchanged pixel-only student and stable control on held-out cells; convert only normalization-array serialization before safe runtime loading.
expected_success_endpoint: Candidate finishes at least as many of twelve cells as control, zero invalid actions, active gas changes, and at least 2% faster jointly completed median lap.
control: StableRiskEnvelopeAgent over selected full-road-guard checkpoint SHA-256 3ceb5ebbe2a4bd96944649a693b8ef924c0252fa620b0fd547c7fb494afff199.
falsifier: Fewer valid finishes than control, invalid actions, no gas interventions or less than 2% paired median lap improvement.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve matched untouched held-out cells, tracks 1–3 × seeds 5208–5211, twenty-four episodes.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 1,800 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no held-out, confirmation, blind, official or external action.
